reason: Compile-time proof of the guarantees the journal kit's types carry: a command's rows handle is read-only, a feature's every fact has exactly one materializer, AlreadyDone is not in the error type the rpc client hands a caller, and an app never carries two features with one name. Every pragma goes unused, and the build fails, if any guarantee is ever relaxed.

Compile-time proof that the rpc assembly rejects a hand-made tag inside a feature's namespace, a tag served by two groups, and two features with one name. A silent merge once let a feature command replace the admiral's hail handler and kill every renderer connection; these pragmas go unused, and the build fails, if the assembly ever accepts such a clash again.
